sent.subject: Re: Vendor pricing - please review
sent.body:
Hi Vendor Pricing team,

Thanks for the thread and the benchmarking data. Based on our cost model, service commitments, and the competitive bids you shared, our proposed rates are as follows (all prices USD, per Standard Package unless noted):

- Standard Package: $12,250
- Standard Package + Priority Implementation (2-week lead): $13,000
- Standard Package + 12-month Premium Support: $14,100

Volume discounts:
- 5–9 units: 3% off list
- 10–19 units: 6% off list
- 20+ units: 10% off list

Additional commercial terms:
- Payment: 30% upfront, 40% on delivery, 30% net 30 days after acceptance
- Offer validity: 45 days
- Delivery: Standard lead time 4 weeks; expedited available as above
- Warranty: 12 months included; extended warranty available

Rationale for these rates:
1) Competitive positioning: The Standard Package price of $12,250 is set slightly below Competitor X and Competitor Z bids you shared, enabling you to be price-competitive while preserving margins. It undercuts the midpoint of the benchmark ($12,833) by ~4.6%.

2) Total cost of ownership (TCO): Our pricing reflects lower TCO through included onboarding, optimized configuration, and reduced maintenance overhead. The premium support option captures customers that prioritize uptime and faster response SLAs.

3) Service & quality premium: We include 2 onsite training sessions and a dedicated account manager in the base price. Those elements increase upfront cost but reduce churn and support burden downstream.

4) Scalability & volume economics: The tiered discounts reflect lower unit costs at scale and are intended to incentivize larger commitments. We’ve structured discounts to balance competitive pricing with protecting margin.

5) Risk management & cashflow: The staged payment terms help fund implementation while aligning final payment to successful acceptance, reducing procurement risk for you.

If you’d like, we can convert these into a formal revised quote with line-item cost breakdowns and configurable options (e.g., specific support SLAs, training hours, or integration services). Please let me know any constraints on target pricing or other priorities (e.g., shorter lead times, longer warranty), and we’ll update the offer accordingly.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
me@company.com
Company, Inc.
